# The construction surface of the finality acceptance surface.
#
# Why this file exists
# --------------------
# An adapter has two doors. Door A is `AdapterSpec::build` in
# `src/cross_domain/external/intake.rs`: it never runs without `register_domain`,
# which refuses a spec whose pin is `None` with `CommitteeNotPinned`. Door B is
# `BridgeEconomicGuard::refresh_backing_from_adapter` in
# `src/cross_domain/economic_guard.rs`: it builds eight adapters directly and
# verifies them without passing through admission.
#
# The `finality-acceptance-surface-has-one-path` gate reads this file and holds
# the tree to it. The surface may only shrink:
#
#   * a production constructor call site that is not listed here fails the gate;
#   * a listed site whose call disappeared fails the gate, because removing a
#     door is progress and must move this file in the same change;
#   * `guarded-variants:` is the number of `GuardedExternalAdapter` variants and
#     must equal the enum's variant count;
#   * a `nonpresence` line records a `has_pinned_trust_anchor` body that is not
#     a single presence test. The design (section 3.5) fixes those bodies; each
#     fix deletes one line here.
#
# Format
# ------
#   guarded-variants: <n>
#   <count> <file>            production constructor call sites in <file>
#   nonpresence <file>        pin body is a conjunction, not one presence test
#
# Measured 2026-11-27 (budlum v3, branch vuslat/tek-kabul-yolu).

guarded-variants: 8

# Door B: `refresh_backing_from_adapter` builds the same eight adapters that
# `GuardedExternalAdapter` declares, one arm per variant - eight construction
# sites that never pass through `register_domain`.
8 src/cross_domain/economic_guard.rs

# The rest of Door A's callers: the CLI opens the admission path directly
# (`ZkVmFinalityAdapter::new`, `TendermintFinalityAdapter::new_pinned`), and the
# settlement light client builds its own Tendermint verifier.
2 src/bin/bud.rs
1 src/settlement/shared_security.rs

# Recorded pin debt (design section 3.5): these bodies accept an anchor OR a
# second pin, so a missing committee can be masked by an SSZ pin, and a ZK
# program without its chain id is not the same anchor as one with it. Each is a
# conjunction today; the fix is one presence test per adapter, and each fix
# deletes its line here.
nonpresence src/cross_domain/external/ethereum.rs
nonpresence src/cross_domain/external/zkvm_proof.rs
